title: Association between the Urinary Sodium to Potassium Ratio and Blood Pressure in Adults
support: Lower 24-h urinary sodium-to-potassium ratio was associated with lower BP in adults; 5 RCT meta-analysis showed greater SBP/DBP reduction with lower ratio.
limitations: Very high heterogeneity; urinary 24-h ratio is not equivalent to dish composition ratio.

title: Vitamin C — Health Professional Fact Sheet
support: Vitamin C improves absorption of nonheme iron.
limitations: Does not imply total dish iron is absorbed iron; high-dose/supplement contexts differ.

title: Vitamin B12 — Health Professional Fact Sheet
support: B12 deficiency can cause megaloblastic anemia and neurologic damage; neurologic manifestations may occur without anemia.
limitations: Individual B12 status cannot be inferred from a dish.
